text:
maria: Quick thread to finalize pilots for multi-region & isolation roadmap. Need 2 pilots + 1 ops experiment.
ben: Agree. Criteria: revenue impact, compliance risk, dev effort, and rollback complexity.
kiran: Routing note: route-by-tenant gives best isolation but needs policy engine changes (2 sprints). route-by-region is faster but coarser.
aj: Perf: hard isolation adds ~30-50ms p99 depending on queueing. Prefix caching reduces p99 by ~15-25ms for many small tenants.
devin: Ops: reserved capacity + automation is the main cost. Estimated 20 devops hrs per hard-isolation pilot; 6 hrs for prefix-cache experiment.
rebecca: Sales: FinLedger renewal in 6 weeks. They require EU residency and audit logs. High priority commercial case.
maria: Proposal: Pilot A = FinLedger (hard isolation, EU), Pilot B = TinyNews (soft isolation + prefix-cache, US), Experiment = prefix-caching rollout across low-volume tenants.
aj: Add acceptance checks: p99 SLO, KMS validated, fallback variant profiled, rollback <5min.
kiran: Migration steps: template policy + reserved pool sizing -> canary 5% traffic -> scale -> full cutover. Risk gates at every step.
devin: Runbook stub: curl ops endpoint to force fallback + health checks. Ill produce PR for automation.
rebecca: I'll draft customer-facing blurbs and contract language for FinLedger.
maria: Owners: Rebecca (customer + commercial), AJ (perf + cost delta), Kiran (routing templates), Devin (runbook + automation), Maria (merge prioritization doc).
opsbot: Reminder: staging KMS tests flapping; tagging @devin.
devin: I'll triage tomorrow morning.
maria: Timeline: get artifacts by Friday, leadership review Monday 10am. Share links when ready.
rebecca: Draft link uploaded to drive (draft).
kiran: Routing impact sheet uploaded.
aj: Perf numbers posted.
devin: Runbook PR opened.
maria: Thanks team. We'll pick pilots Monday. :thumbsup:
